title: knowledge(style): a new procedure that changes the page's current record should take it as var Record
summary: New style guidance document for AL developers on when procedures that modify a record should take the record as a var parameter, with good and bad code samples and exclusions.
key_points: Added knowledge article about mutating procedures on pages should accept records as var parameters
Explains how passing records by value causes stale data issues when pages modify records through procedures
Documents cost and constraints of var parameters including filter preservation requirements
Lists exclusions such as job queue entry points, API actions, and record ID based procedures
Integrated into style review checklist and test fixtures
